fixtures.name: quiet_rook_geometry
fixtures.manual_explanation: Re8 attacks Kf8 along rank8; Re3 shares neither rank nor file with Kf8. Both moves originate at e2 and are quiet rook moves.

fixtures.name: same_victim_knight_capture
fixtures.manual_explanation: Bxg7 attacks Kh8 on the adjacent diagonal; Bxa7 does not. Both capture knights; Bxe3 captures a rook and cannot match that capture type.

fixtures.name: pinned_rook_apparent_check_is_illegal
fixtures.manual_explanation: Rf2 would line up with Kf8 but exposes Ke1 to the black rook on e8. Rxe8 is a checking capture without a matching nonchecking capture.
